requirements.acceptance: Client reports region/side pain directly on the full detailed viewer; no explorer prerequisite; median≤30s in planned usability study.
Pain, Recovery and Explore retain the same full viewer/catalog; all source capabilities remain reachable; return preserves target and draft.
Same-episode observations append; unrelated regions never drive the same pain trend.
Every private read/write enforces self, assigned trainer or authorized admin; target races reveal no other data.
Strict v2 validation and same-key retries produce at most one committed observation.
Pinned source/custom assets, stable IDs, laterality, semantic maps, licensing and content pass catalog review.
Client and staff role features, legacy records and all mapped writer paths retain compatibility.
Pain pulse is controllable; reduced motion, keyboard, WebGL failure and touch reporting have full parity.
Recovery derives from persisted completed workouts and canonical exercise/set identities, never charts or plans as extra input.
Unknown mapping, missing RPE, stale/error and unsupported modality never imply fresh or healthy.
Workout edits/deletes/imports update one source revision reflected by atlas, locker, private charts and Coach.
Estimates require an enabled reviewed calibration profile, version and coverage; formula deterministic under fixture clock.
Reported pain remains independent and cannot be resolved by load decay or an estimate.
Each muscle summary explains source workouts, timestamps, mapping/estimate status and limitations.
Recovery evidence is private by default; public social and providers do not inherit detailed health access.
Coach uses one authoritative target; composer reachable without initial document scroll.
Talk, Review, History, notes, voice, intake, audio, drafts and registry actions have explicit retained destinations.
Unknown/expired roles fail closed in UI and server; client switching fences stale results.
Confirm/cancel/unknown-outcome recovery preserve current durable backend intent and at-most-once effects.
Review presents one truthful task state; History scope and source target are explicit.
Coach can explain pain/recovery facts and propose adjustments without silently applying programs.
Doctrinal, independent and hybrid design directions are tangible, provenance-labeled and compared fairly.
Brain upgrade resolves functional3D, surface precedence, density and clean-review conflicts without losing Swan identity.
Canonical design.md, generated mirrors, adapters and actual runtime invocation remain distinct and verifiable.
Existing baseline results, source/worktree conflicts and future test gaps are explicit; no app success inferred from docs.
Original plans and completed packet have verified local snapshots; app files remain unchanged by this task.
Every requirement has acceptance, artifact, slice and test; conditional artifacts all apply; skill is reusable.
Migration, restore, observability, rollout and performance budgets have owners and executable acceptance procedures.
Initial Swan port reproduces actual Human Atlas scene/assets/tools before customization; no schematic substitute.
Portable teaching prompt preserves detailed objects, useful interaction and project identity; actual-agent benchmark proves invocation before runtime claims.
Diverse body options support all backgrounds through actual available source/derived/custom assets; no nationality inference; shipped variants preserve full anatomy/tools.
Measured mode adapts from authorized saved inputs with provenance where rig supports it; manual mode preserves chosen reference; no visual adjustment rewrites health facts.
Planner and Pain Atlas share one scoped measured/manual preference; source updates respect mode; actual measurements alone inform workout logic.
Bounded derivative feasibility can continue customization or defer it; authorized source fallback preserves full Three.js, Swan workflows and honest capability labels.
New reports default to Easy; broad region/side/score saves without tissue classification; optional muscle/bone/joint aids and secondary Explore preserve full anatomy and the draft.
